args.description: a single old olive tree seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. A thick gnarled twisting trunk of grey-brown bark splitting into a few heavy limbs, a broad rounded canopy of small silver-green leaves in clumps with gaps of sky showing through, a few dark olives, exposed roots gripping dry earth at the base. Warm sunlit palette of olive green, silver-grey green and grey-brown bark. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

a low round Mediterranean scrub bush seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Dense small dark olive-green leaves on thin woody stems, a rounded silhouette wider than it is tall, a few dry brown twigs sticking out, sitting on dry earth. Warm palette of olive green and dry brown. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

a clump of tall dry coastal grass seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Straw-coloured blades fanning upward and outward from a single base, some bending over at the tip, a few olive-green blades among them, growing out of pale sandy ground. Warm palette of straw yellow, dry ochre and a little olive green. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

a group of ancient Greek storage vessels standing on the ground, seen from directly beside them, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Two large round-bellied terracotta storage jars with narrow necks and small handles, one smaller jar tipped over on its side, and two woven reed baskets with visible weave, one with a cloth over it. Warm palette of terracotta orange, reddish clay and pale straw. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

an ancient stone well head seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. A circular wall of fitted pale limestone blocks about waist height, two plain wooden posts either side carrying a horizontal wooden crossbar, a rope hanging down from the bar with a wooden bucket on the end, wet dark stains on the stone, a puddle at the base. Warm palette of pale limestone, cool grey stone and brown timber. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

a simple ancient wooden handcart seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. A flat plank bed on a single large spoked wooden wheel, two long straight handles tilting down to rest on the ground, rough brown timber with visible grain and iron nails, a sack and a few loose branches loaded on the bed. Warm palette of brown timber and pale straw. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

a rustic wooden fence seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Rough vertical posts of split timber driven into dry earth, two horizontal rails lashed across them with cord, uneven post heights, weathered grey-brown wood with visible grain, a few tufts of dry grass at the base. Warm palette of brown timber, weathered grey and straw. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

a small ancient Greek fishing boat pulled up on sand, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. A shallow wooden hull of overlapping planks curving up at both ends, a single short mast with the sail furled and tied to it, wooden oars resting across the gunwale, coils of rope and a folded net inside, the hull resting tilted on the sand. Warm palette of brown timber, pale undyed sailcloth and sand. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
